subject: Q4 prep: leadership digest — OKR checkpoints, consolidated forecasts, account synopses
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q4 prep: leadership digest — OKR checkpoints, consolidated forecasts, account synopses

Team —

As we lock in Q4 planning, I want a concise leadership digest to take into the Friday review with execs. Please treat this as a working thread for: OKR checkpoints, a single consolidated forecast spreadsheet, and short account-by-account synopses for any top-10 or at-risk deals. Key asks: 

- Forecast rollup: combine field forecasts + CS inputs into one spreadsheet (see attached template) and tag best-case / commit / upside per account.
- Account synopses: 1-paragraph status + 2 next actions + owner for each flagged account (Acme Corp, BlueStem Health, L-Enterprise Inc.). Use the attached Acme template for formatting.
- OKR checkpoints: call out progress vs. Q4 ARR target, expansion motions, and one operational risk (latency/SLO, billing friction, or security review) per account if applicable.

Deadline: consolidated file + synopses in Drive by EOD 2027-10-01 so I can compile slides Friday evening. If you need a short handoff call, ping me — otherwise drop items directly in the sheet.

I've attached forecast_rollup_v3.xlsx and Acme_account_brief_template.docx to get us started. I'm assigning initial owners below — feel free to reassign explicitly in replies:

- Acme Corp — Laura
- BlueStem Health — Rishi
- L-Enterprise Inc. — Tessa

Thanks — let's keep this tight.

Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: forecast_rollup_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Acme_account_brief_template.docx (docx)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 prep: leadership digest — OKR checkpoints, consolidated forecasts, account synopses

Markus —

Thanks for the clear asks. I started the Acme brief and pushed a first-pass sheet into Drive (link below). Quick notes:

- Acme: procurement timeline slipped two weeks; they want a security memo (we should pull SOC2 artifact) before committing. Current commit is $1.2M, upside $300K.
- I've added contact / legal touchpoints and noted their security owner (J. Salas).
- I flagged a billing integration risk — their internal finance requires separate invoice recipients.

I'll finish the one-paragraph synopsis and next actions by 10/01 EOD. Attaching the partial forecast I pulled from my field sheet.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: laura_acme_partial_forecast.csv (csv)
Link: https://drive.redwood/example/laura_acme_partial

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 prep: leadership digest — OKR checkpoints, consolidated forecasts, account synopses

Markus / Laura —

Adding my prioritization POV:

- Focus: Acme (DL-7284) and BlueStem are highest impact for Q4 ARR and have gating items we can influence.
- For BlueStem: procurement@bluestem.com wants a managed VPC option in the contract. If engineering signs off on deployment timeline, we can accelerate to a November close.
- Suggest we include a 1-slide MAP (mutual action plan) for each of the top-5 deals; that will help execs see convertibility.

I'll drop my BlueStem brief and a proposed MAP into the Drive folder by 9/30. Also logged DL-7284 in HubSpot with current stage and next steps.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Field Ops
Redwood Inference

Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated: Q4 forecast + leadership digest (final drop)

Markus / team —

I've merged the inputs into the single rollup and exported the deck-ready snapshot. Drive links below. Changes of note:

- Consolidated commit: $9.1M; upside: $1.7M. Commit moved +$400K after reconciling field/CS numbers (Laura's Acme update included).
- Acme (DL-7284): commit retained at $1.2M, procurement now requires SOC2 excerpts and a billing contact change — Laura added those details.
- BlueStem: moved to commit pending engineering signoff on managed VPC; Rishi's MAP is in the folder.
- OKR checkpoint: On-track for pipeline coverage (3.6x) but expansion motions lag by ~12% to target — recommend a targeted upsell campaign for three named accounts next month.

Files uploaded: forecast_rollup_v4.xlsx (master), leadership_digest_onepager.pdf (for execs), account_synopses_acme_bluestem_others.zip (zipped briefs).

Next steps I built into the sheet:
- Laura: finalize Acme brief and add SOC2 link in the Terra column.
- Rishi: confirm engineering deployment ETA for BlueStem and update the MAP close probability.
- Tessa: please surface any L-Enterprise gating items by EOD tomorrow so I can fold into the final slides.

I'll compile the exec slide pack after your updates on 10/02 morning. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

—Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference

Drive links: https://drive.redwood/example/forecast_rollup_v4, https://drive.redwood/example/leadership_digest_onepager
Attachments: forecast_rollup_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet), leadership_digest_onepager.pdf (pdf), account_synopses_acme_bluestem_others.zip (zip)
